policy: Studio versions below are conditional targets; the lean library alpha.1 is published with separate registry evidence. Implementation, issue closure and human acceptance are separate. Prerequisites refer to the named capability, not every checkbox in an umbrella issue.

milestones.exit: Historical alpha.0 engineering candidate: deterministic browser/Node/CLI evidence and bounded structured-input pilots. Current personal-scope alpha.1 registry bytes and fresh install are verified; human acceptance remains open.

Experimental alpha.1 is published: exact registry archive bytes and a fresh three-package runtime/TypeScript consumer are verified. Lean/browser distribution checks pass in their own scopes. Independent artist usefulness remains open in #70; physical/human acceptance and native binary notices remain separate in #13/#14. No print-quality claim.

Experimental prerelease published 19 October 2026 at source aec0c23. Attached browser build size and digest match the verified archive. The owner-supplied live print export passes digital checks and two-page visual inspection. Human accessibility remains open; physical and independent artist trials are owner-deferred. Native notices block native bundles only. See docs/CREATIVE-USE-2026-10-19.md.

Close the RC acceptance plus representative physical-print observations and notices/provenance for the shipped export artifacts. Do not call an untested effect press-calibrated. #3/#4/#10 remain optional case-study/expanded diagnostics; they still count in the original 14-issue backlog.
Owner/artist reviews and intended-size physical tests justify each changed mask recipe. Increment the affected family/variant version; do not silently alter saved recipes.
Each extension needs a concrete workflow, appropriate evidence and its own approval. Identity experiments, Java hosting, vector geometry and cosmetic work do not block the small JS alpha.
Complete controlled comparisons, representation and dependency review, then adopt/defer/reject each candidate. Research completion is not production implementation or print validation.
